environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster but namespace 'prod-audit' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' level). Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy resource with matchConstraints on the namespace enforces that spec.volumes[*].hostPath must be null and spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged must not be true. The OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sPSPHostFilesystem' with parameter 'allowedHostPaths: []' is also active on this namespace. Container forced to run as non-root UID 65534 with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and the only writable path is an emptyDir at /var/log/audit (ephemeral, pod-scoped).
